title: Thai Red Curry with Shrimp
description: Shrimp and vegetables simmered in a fragrant coconut red curry sauce with lime and basil. Ready in about 25 minutes.

image.alt: A bowl of red curry with shrimp, peppers and basil, beside rice

steps.text: Start the rice if you’re serving it. Heat the oil in the skillet over medium heat, add the curry paste and fry, stirring, until fragrant, {time 1 min}.
Stir in the coconut milk, broth, fish sauce and brown sugar and bring to a simmer.
Add the bell pepper and zucchini and simmer until just tender, {time 5 min}.
Add the shrimp and simmer until pink and opaque, {time 3-4 min}. Take the pan off the heat and stir in the lime juice and basil. Taste and add more fish sauce or lime if needed. Serve over rice.

notes: Curry pastes vary a lot in heat. Start with less and add more once you’ve tasted the sauce.
Chicken thigh strips work in place of shrimp; simmer them for 8 to 10 minutes.
